Name: Monster Musk Cost Selector for CP
Author: keithmfrench
Description:
Allows for selecting how much slime and bat wings it will costs to craft monster musk.

You can make it cheaper or more expensive, it is up to you.
Just put in how much you want in the config file. I suggest using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10505]GMCM Options[/url]﻿.

Defaults to 30 slime and 30 bat wings, which is the normal cost.

Does not change how you get the recipe.

Manifest.Name: (CP) Monster Musk Cost
Manifest.Description: Change the cost of monster musk.
Manifest.Author: KMF
